<!-- wp:html -->
<style id="bcz-redesign-css">* { box-sizing: border-box; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 150px; }
body { margin: 0; color: #102f3a; background: #ffffff; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Inter", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65; font-kerning: normal; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; }
body.menu-open { overflow: hidden; }
a { color: inherit; }
img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
.shell { width: min(calc(100% - 56px), 1180px); margin-inline: auto; }
.narrow { max-width: 860px; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.skip-link { position: fixed; z-index: 1000; top: 12px; left: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; border: 2px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; font-weight: 800; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 20px 52px rgba(8, 38, 48, .13); transform: translateY(-160%); transition: transform .16s ease; }
.skip-link:focus { transform: translateY(0); }
.concept-bar { padding: 6px 16px; color: #3d2900; background: #fff3df; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 760; }

.site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; border-top: 4px solid #f39200; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 79, 98, .14); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .98); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(8, 38, 48, .05); }
.utility { min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: #557078; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf1f1; font-size: 13px; }
.utility div { display: flex; gap: 24px; }
.utility a { min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; }
.utility a:hover { color: #004f62; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.nav-shell { min-height: 82px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; }
.brand { min-height: 52px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-right: auto; text-decoration: none; }
.brand-logo { width: clamp(190px, 18vw, 238px); display: block; flex: none; }
.brand-logo img { width: 100%; height: auto; }
#site-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
#site-nav a { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #284e54; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
#site-nav a:hover { color: #004f62; border-color: #afc5c8; }
#site-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: #003f50; border-color: #f39200; }
.menu-toggle { width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 13px; display: none; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }
.menu-toggle > span:not(.sr-only) { height: 2px; margin: 4px 0; display: block; background: #102f3a; }

.button { min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 2px solid #004f62; border-radius: 8px; color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; font-weight: 760; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); transition: transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease, background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease; }
.button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: #003f50; background: #003f50; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.button:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; }
.button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; box-shadow: none; }
.button-small { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; font-size: 14px; }
.button-secondary { color: #004f62; background: #ffffff; }
.button-secondary:hover { color: #ffffff; }
.button-gold, .header-cta { border-color: #f39200; color: #302000; background: #f39200; }
.button-gold:hover, .header-cta:hover { border-color: #c96f00; color: #241800; background: #e88600; }
.button-on-dark { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.62); color: #ffffff; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
.button-on-dark:hover { border-color: #ffffff; color: #003f50; background: #ffffff; }
.button-full { width: 100%; }
.text-link { min-height: 44px !important; display: inline-flex !important; align-items: center; color: #004f62; font-weight: 760; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 5px; }
.button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 3px; }

h1, h2, h3, p { margin-top: 0; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #082630; font-weight: 760; }
h1 { max-width: 850px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 66px); line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -.045em; text-wrap: balance; }
h2 { margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: clamp(30px, 3.35vw, 44px); line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.035em; text-wrap: balance; }
h3 { margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: clamp(21px, 2vw, 25px); line-height: 1.22; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
.eyebrow { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #004f62; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.lead { max-width: 720px; margin-bottom: 32px; color: #46636b; font-size: clamp(18px, 2vw, 21px); line-height: 1.55; }
.article-meta { margin: calc(-1 * 4px) 0 16px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; color: #557078; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; }
.article-meta span { padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid #afc5c8; }
.hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
.breadcrumbs { margin-bottom: 48px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #557078; font-size: 13px; }
.breadcrumbs a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

.hero, .service-hero, .inner-hero, .quote-hero { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; background: #fbfaf7; }
.hero::after, .service-hero::after, .inner-hero::after, .quote-hero::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto; height: 6px; background: #004f62; }
.home-hero, .pricing-hero { padding: clamp(72px, 8vw, 112px) 0 clamp(82px, 9vw, 124px); }
.home-hero { isolation: isolate; color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; }
.home-hero::before { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: 1; inset: 0; background: rgba(0, 35, 45, .82); }
.home-hero::after { z-index: 3; }
.home-hero-media { position: absolute; z-index: 0; inset: 0; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.home-hero-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 58%; }
.home-hero .hero-grid { z-index: 2; }
.home-hero .hero-copy h1 { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(0, 20, 27, .22); }
.home-hero .hero-copy > .eyebrow { color: #ffc566; }
.home-hero .hero-copy > .lead { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .84); }
.home-hero .hero-copy > .proof-list { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .88); }
.home-hero .hero-copy > .proof-list li::before { color: #003f50; background: #ffffff; }
.hero-grid { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.02fr) minmax(420px, .82fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(52px, 7vw, 92px); }
.proof-list, .check-list { margin: 32px 0 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; display: grid; gap: 12px; list-style: none !important; color: #355761; font-size: 14px; }
.proof-list li, .check-list li { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; list-style: none !important; }
.proof-list li::marker, .check-list li::marker { content: ""; }
.proof-list li::before, .check-list li::before { content: "✓"; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin-top: 1px; display: inline-grid; flex: 0 0 22px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; }
.inner-hero { padding: clamp(82px, 8vw, 116px) 0 clamp(78px, 8vw, 108px); }
.inner-hero .narrow { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.service-hero { padding: 58px 0 88px; }
.service-hero-grid { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(340px, .72fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px); }
.service-aside { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.service-photo { height: 235px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: #f6f3ed; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.service-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.decision-card { padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #d7e2e3; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.decision-card h2 { font-size: 30px; }
.decision-card .check-list { margin-top: 24px !important; }

.estimator { position: relative; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 6px solid #f39200; border-radius: 20px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 20px 52px rgba(8, 38, 48, .13); }
.estimator-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
.estimator h2 { margin-bottom: 0; font-size: 31px; }
.step-badge { flex: none; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #eccf9d; border-radius: 999px; color: #513300; background: #fff3df; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 760; }
.form-intro { margin-bottom: 24px; color: #557078; font-size: 14px; }
.field-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
label { margin-bottom: 16px; display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #304f58; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
input, select, textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 11px 13px; border: 1px solid #9fb7bb; border-radius: 8px; color: #102f3a; background: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; }
textarea { resize: vertical; }
input:hover, select:hover, textarea:hover { border-color: #718f95; }
input[aria-invalid="true"], textarea[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #b42318; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(180,35,24,.12); }
.estimate-lines { margin: 12px 0 16px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.estimate-lines > div { padding: 6px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; font-size: 14px; }
.estimate-lines strong { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.estimate-lines .subtotal { margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed #afc5c8; }
.estimate-lines .grand-total { margin-top: 12px; padding: 16px; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; font-size: 16px; }
.grand-total strong { font-size: 25px; }
.estimate-note { color: #557078; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

.trust-band { color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; }
.trust-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
.trust-grid > div { min-height: 104px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
.trust-grid > div:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.trust-grid span { color: rgba(255,255,255,.68); font-size: 12px; }
.trust-grid strong { margin-top: 4px; color: #ffffff; font-size: 15px; }

.section { position: relative; padding-top: clamp(80px, 8.5vw, 120px); padding-bottom: clamp(80px, 8.5vw, 120px); }
.soft, .pricing-preview, .faq-section { border-block: 1px solid #e4eaeb; background: #f6f3ed; }
.section-heading { margin-bottom: clamp(36px, 5vw, 60px); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(280px, .65fr); align-items: end; gap: clamp(36px, 7vw, 88px); }
.section-heading h2 { max-width: 680px; margin-bottom: 0; }
.section-heading > p { max-width: 520px; margin-bottom: 4px; color: #557078; }
.photo-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.35fr .825fr .825fr; gap: 16px; }
.photo-card { position: relative; min-height: 330px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: #f6f3ed; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.photo-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 330px; object-fit: cover; transition: transform .24s ease; }
.photo-card:hover img { transform: scale(1.012); }
.photo-card figcaption { position: absolute; inset: auto 12px 12px; max-width: calc(100% - 24px); padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #102f3a; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }

.service-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.service-card { min-height: 208px; padding: 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; column-gap: 24px; border: 1px solid #d7e2e3; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; transition: transform .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease; }
.service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #afc5c8; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.card-number { width: 50px; height: 50px; grid-row: 1 / 4; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #003f50; background: #e9f3f4; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.card-number svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.service-card h3 { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.service-card p { max-width: 42ch; margin-bottom: 16px; color: #557078; font-size: 15px; }
.service-card a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #004f62; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 760; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

.editorial-section { color: #ffffff; background: #082630; }
.editorial-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, .82fr); gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px); align-items: center; }
.editorial-grid h2 { color: #ffffff; }
.editorial-grid .eyebrow { color: #ffc667; }
.editorial-grid p:not(.eyebrow) { color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); }
.editorial-grid .text-link { color: #ffffff; }
.editorial-grid .check-list { color: rgba(255,255,255,.82); }
.move-photo { position: relative; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: #003f50; box-shadow: 0 22px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.24); }
.move-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }
.move-photo figcaption { position: absolute; inset: auto 16px 16px; max-width: 340px; padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 8px; color: #102f3a; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.box-tool-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(300px, .38fr); gap: 48px; align-items: stretch; }
.converter-stack { display: grid; gap: 24px; }
.box-converter { padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 6px solid #f39200; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbfaf7; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.box-converter h3 { margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 26px; }
.box-converter label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #102f3a; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 760; }
.box-converter input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-radius: 8px; color: #102f3a; background: #ffffff; font: inherit; }
.box-converter-result { margin: 24px 0; padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 4px; border-radius: 8px; color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; }
.box-converter-result span { color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font-size: 12px; }
.box-converter-result strong { font-size: 22px; }
.box-converter .field-note { margin: 12px 0 0; color: #557078; font-size: 12px; }
.dimension-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.dimension-fields .field-with-unit { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px; }
.visual-story { position: relative; min-height: 440px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 20px; background: #003f50; }
.visual-story::before, .visual-story::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: 50%; }
.visual-story::before { width: 380px; height: 380px; right: -90px; top: -80px; }
.visual-story::after { width: 250px; height: 250px; left: -80px; bottom: -100px; }
.route-label { position: absolute; z-index: 2; padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 999px; color: #102f3a; background: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 760; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.route-a { left: 8%; top: 19%; }
.route-b { right: 8%; bottom: 18%; }
.route-line { position: absolute; left: 20%; top: 30%; width: 60%; height: 40%; border-bottom: 3px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.55); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-9deg); }
.route-van { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 45%; top: 42%; width: 110px; height: 76px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; color: #302000; background: #f39200; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 850; line-height: 1.05; text-align: center; transform: rotate(-4deg); }

.pricing-grid, .split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, .68fr) minmax(0, 1.18fr); gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 88px); align-items: center; }
.pricing-grid > div:first-child p:not(.eyebrow), .split > div:first-child p:not(.eyebrow) { color: #557078; }
.rates { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 6px solid #f39200; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.rate-row { min-height: 88px; padding: 17px 22px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 24px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.rate-row:nth-child(even) { background: #fbfaf7; }
.rate-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.rate-row > div { display: grid; }
.rate-row > div:last-child { text-align: right; }
.rate-row > div:last-child strong { color: #004f62; font-size: 22px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.rate-row span { color: #557078; font-size: 12px; }
.calculation-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 6px solid #004f62; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.calculation-row { min-height: 68px; padding: 12px 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.calculation-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.calculation-row span { color: #557078; font-size: 14px; }
.calculation-row strong { color: #082630; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.calculation-row.subtotal { background: #fbfaf7; }
.calculation-row.total { color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; }
.calculation-row.total span, .calculation-row.total strong { color: #ffffff; }

.process, .definition-grid { margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px; list-style: none; }
.definition-grid-four { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
.process li, .definition-grid article { min-height: 196px; padding: 32px 0; border-top: 3px solid #f39200; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; background: transparent; }
.process li { display: flex; gap: 16px; }
.process li > span, .definition-grid article > span { color: #004f62; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .1em; }
.process p, .definition-grid p { color: #557078; font-size: 15px; }
.faq-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(250px, .62fr) minmax(0, 1.18fr); gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px); }
.faq-grid > div:first-child > p:last-child { color: #557078; }
.faq-list { border-top: 1px solid #afc5c8; }
details { border-bottom: 1px solid #afc5c8; }
summary { position: relative; padding: 24px 42px 24px 4px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 740; list-style: none; }
summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
summary::after { content: "+"; position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 18px; color: #004f62; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 400; }
details[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
details p { max-width: 720px; padding: 0 4px 24px; color: #46636b; }

.content-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(300px, .66fr); gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px); align-items: start; }
.content-grid > div > p:not(.eyebrow) { max-width: 720px; color: #557078; }
.side-note, .contact-card { padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #d7e2e3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbfaf7; }
.side-note > strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 20px; }
.side-note p { color: #557078; }
.journey { display: grid; gap: 0; }
.journey article { padding: 64px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px minmax(0, 720px); gap: 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.journey article:first-child { padding-top: 0; }
.journey article > span { color: #c96f00; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
.journey p:not(.eyebrow) { color: #557078; }
.map-card { min-height: 400px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; border-radius: 20px; color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; }
.map-rings { position: relative; min-height: 260px; flex: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; isolation: isolate; }
.map-rings::before, .map-rings::after { content: ""; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24); }
.map-rings::before { width: min(88%, 310px); aspect-ratio: 1; }
.map-rings::after { width: min(58%, 205px); aspect-ratio: 1; border-style: dashed; border-color: rgba(255,177,0,.6); }
.map-rings span { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: 10px 15px; border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius: 999px; color: #302000; background: #f39200; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.map-node { position: absolute; z-index: 2; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 3px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; background: #f39200; box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.24); }
.map-node-a { top: 20%; left: 22%; }
.map-node-b { right: 17%; bottom: 29%; }
.map-node-c { bottom: 16%; left: 30%; }
.map-card p { margin-bottom: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.75); font-size: 14px; }
.facts { margin: 32px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.facts div { padding: 16px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 160px 1fr; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.facts dt { color: #557078; }
.facts dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 720; }
.contact-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.contact-photo { width: 100%; height: 220px; margin-bottom: 12px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 12px; }
.contact-card h2 { font-size: 30px; }
.contact-card > a:not(.button) { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 740; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.article-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
.article-card { min-height: 270px; padding: 32px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-top: 3px solid #004f62; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; background: transparent; }
.article-card > span { margin-bottom: 32px; color: #c96f00; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.article-card h2 { max-width: 520px; font-size: 29px; }
.article-card p { max-width: 54ch; color: #557078; }
.article-card a { min-height: 44px; margin-top: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #004f62; font-weight: 740; text-underline-offset: 4px; }

.inline-actions { margin-top: 24px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 32px; }
.local-check-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
.local-check-card { min-height: 290px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 5px solid #f39200; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.local-check-card > span, .tip-card > span { display: block; margin-bottom: 32px; color: #c96f00; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 850; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.local-check-card h3, .tip-card h3 { font-size: 25px; }
.local-check-card p { margin-bottom: 0; color: #557078; font-size: 15px; }
.source-panel { margin-top: 48px; padding: 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(280px, .7fr); gap: 32px; align-items: start; border-left: 5px solid #004f62; border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; background: #e9f3f4; }
.source-panel strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #082630; font-size: 21px; }
.source-panel p { max-width: 68ch; margin-bottom: 0; color: #355761; }
.source-links { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.source-links a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: #004f62; font-weight: 740; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; }
.compact-source { margin-top: 64px; }
.content-grid > .source-panel { margin-top: 0; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.timeline-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
.tip-card { min-height: 390px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(8, 38, 48, .06); }
.tip-card .check-list { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.tip-card .text-link { margin-top: auto; }

.review-section { background: #ffffff; }
.review-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, .55fr) minmax(0, 1.25fr); gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px); align-items: start; }
.review-score { padding: 32px; border-left: 5px solid #f39200; background: #fbfaf7; }
.review-score strong { display: block; color: #082630; font-size: clamp(44px, 6vw, 66px); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.05em; }
.review-score span { display: block; margin-top: 8px; color: #557078; }
.stars { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin: 16px 0; color: #c96f00; }
.stars svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; }
.review-list { display: grid; gap: 0; border-top: 1px solid #afc5c8; }
.review-item { padding: 24px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.review-item strong { color: #082630; }
.review-item p { margin-bottom: 0; color: #3f5f68; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.55; }
.review-meta { margin-top: 4px; display: block; color: #557078; font-size: 13px; }

.authority-band { border-block: 1px solid #d7e2e3; background: #fbfaf7; }
.authority-grid { min-height: 122px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
.authority-item { padding: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-left: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.authority-item:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.authority-icon { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #004f62; background: #e9f3f4; }
.authority-icon svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.authority-item span { display: block; color: #557078; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.authority-item strong { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: #082630; font-size: 14px; }
.authority-item a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

.quote-hero { padding: 58px 0 68px; }
.quote-intro { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.quote-intro-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(360px, .7fr); align-items: center; gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px); }
.quote-intro-photo { height: 310px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #d7e2e3; border-radius: 20px; background: #f6f3ed; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.quote-intro-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
.quote-proof { margin: 32px 0 0; padding: 24px 0 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; border-top: 1px solid #afc5c8; list-style: none; color: #355761; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 690; }
.quote-proof li { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }
.quote-proof li::before { content: "✓"; width: 22px; height: 22px; display: inline-grid; flex: 0 0 22px; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; }
.quote-workspace { background: #f6f3ed; }
.calculator-workspace { border-block: 1px solid #d7e2e3; background: #f6f3ed; }
.calculator-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(300px, .52fr); align-items: start; gap: clamp(32px, 5vw, 64px); }
.calculator-panel { padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px); border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 6px solid #f39200; border-radius: 20px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.calculator-panel .inventory-toolbar { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.calculator-panel .inventory-toolbar h2 { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.calculator-panel .inventory-toolbar p:not(.eyebrow) { margin-bottom: 0; color: #557078; }
.calculator-summary { position: sticky; top: 150px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-radius: 20px; background: #003f50; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 20px 52px rgba(8, 38, 48, .13); }
.calculator-summary h2 { color: #ffffff; font-size: 28px; }
.calculator-summary .eyebrow { color: #ffc667; }
.calculator-summary > span, .calculator-summary > p { display: block; color: rgba(255,255,255,.76); }
.calculator-summary > p { margin: 24px 0; font-size: 14px; }
.calculator-summary .text-link { margin-top: 12px; color: #ffffff; }
.m3-total { margin: 16px 0 8px; display: block; color: #ffffff; font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 58px); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.box-equivalent { margin-top: 24px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
.box-equivalent span, .box-equivalent strong { display: block; }
.box-equivalent span { color: rgba(255,255,255,.68); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.box-equivalent strong { margin-top: 4px; color: #ffffff; font-size: 15px; }
.m3-selection { margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.m3-selection > span { display: block; color: #ffc667; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; }
.m3-selection ul { max-height: 170px; margin: 8px 0 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; overflow: auto; list-style: none; scrollbar-gutter: stable; }
.m3-selection li { color: rgba(255,255,255,.86); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.extra-volume { margin: 32px 0 0; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.extra-volume small { color: #557078; font-weight: 500; }
.field-with-unit { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 180px) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.field-with-unit > span { color: #557078; }
.m3-hero-photo { height: 360px; }
.quote-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, .7fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr); align-items: start; gap: clamp(48px, 7vw, 88px); }
.privacy-note { max-width: 620px; margin-top: 48px; padding: 24px; border-left: 4px solid #f39200; background: #ffffff; }
.privacy-note p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #557078; font-size: 14px; }
.quote-form { min-height: 650px; padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px); border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-top: 6px solid #f39200; border-radius: 20px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.form-progress { margin-bottom: 48px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 8px; color: #557078; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 740; }
.form-progress span { min-width: 0; padding-top: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-top: 3px solid #d7e2e3; }
.form-progress b { width: 24px; height: 24px; display: inline-grid; flex: 0 0 24px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-radius: 50%; color: #557078; background: #ffffff; font-size: 11px; }
.form-progress span.active { color: #004f62; border-color: #f39200; }
.form-progress span.active b { border-color: #004f62; color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; }
.form-step { display: block; }
.js .form-step { display: none; }
.js .form-step.active { display: block; }
.form-step h2 { font-size: 31px; }
.step-intro { max-width: 740px; margin-bottom: 32px; color: #557078; }
fieldset { margin: 0 0 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; }
legend { margin-bottom: 12px; color: #304f58; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; }
.choice-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.choice-grid label { margin: 0; }
.choice-grid input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; min-height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); clip-path: inset(50%); opacity: 0; white-space: nowrap; }
.choice-grid label span { min-height: 84px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #9fb7bb; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; }
.choice-grid label span { position: relative; padding-left: 74px; }
.choice-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 50%; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 7px; transform: translateY(-50%); border-radius: 10px; color: #004f62; background: #e9f3f4; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.choice-grid input:checked + span { border: 2px solid #004f62; background: #e9f3f4; }
.choice-grid input:checked + span .choice-icon { color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; }
.choice-grid input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; }
.choice-grid small { color: #557078; }
.three-fields { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.address-grid { margin-bottom: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.address-card { margin: 0; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #afc5c8; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbfaf7; }
.stopover-panel { margin: 24px 0; display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.stopover-toggle { max-width: 660px; }
.stopover-card { border-top: 5px solid #f39200; background: #ffffff; }
.stopover-access-grid { margin-top: 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .7fr) minmax(240px, 1fr); gap: 16px; align-items: end; }
.address-card legend { width: 100%; margin: 0 0 16px; padding: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.address-card legend > span:last-child { display: grid; }
.address-card legend strong { color: #082630; font-size: 17px; }
.address-card legend small { color: #557078; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.panel-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; display: grid; flex: 0 0 40px; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; }
.panel-icon-orange { color: #302000; background: #f39200; }
.panel-icon svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.address-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(86px, .65fr) minmax(74px, .5fr); gap: 12px; }
.address-fields label { margin: 0; }
.street-field { grid-column: 1 / 3; }
.city-field { grid-column: 3; }
.input-suffix { position: relative; display: block; }
.input-suffix input { padding-right: 52px; }
.input-suffix em { position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 14px; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #557078; font-size: 13px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 760; pointer-events: none; }
.access-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
.check-tile { min-height: 76px; margin: 0; padding: 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid #9fb7bb; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; cursor: pointer; }
.check-tile:has(input:checked) { border: 2px solid #004f62; background: #e9f3f4; }
.check-tile input { width: 20px; min-height: 20px; margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: #004f62; }
.check-tile input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: 2px; }
.check-tile span { display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.check-tile strong { color: #082630; }
.check-tile small { color: #557078; font-weight: 500; }
.service-choice-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
.inventory-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 290px; align-items: start; gap: 32px; }
.inventory-toolbar { min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
.text-button { min-height: 44px; padding: 6px 0; border: 0; color: #004f62; background: transparent; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 760; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; }
.text-button:hover { color: #c96f00; }
.inventory-search { margin: 12px 0 16px; gap: 8px; }
.inventory-search > span:first-child { color: #082630; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 760; }
.search-field { position: relative; display: block; }
.search-field svg { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: 50%; left: 15px; width: 20px; height: 20px; transform: translateY(-50%); fill: none; stroke: #004f62; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; pointer-events: none; }
.search-field input { padding-left: 46px; background: #ffffff; }
.inventory-search small { min-height: 18px; color: #557078; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.compact-search { max-width: 560px; }
.inventory-group { margin-bottom: 12px; border: 1px solid #d7e2e3; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; overflow: hidden; }
.inventory-group summary { min-height: 72px; padding: 12px 16px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #082630; background: #fbfaf7; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; }
.inventory-group summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.inventory-group summary::after { content: "+"; grid-column: 3; color: #004f62; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; }
.inventory-group[open] summary::after { content: "−"; }
.inventory-group summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1769e0; outline-offset: -3px; }
.inventory-group summary > span:nth-child(2) { display: grid; }
.inventory-group summary small { color: #557078; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }
.inventory-group-icon { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; color: #004f62; background: #e9f3f4; }
.inventory-group-icon svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.inventory-items { padding: 0 16px; border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.inventory-row { min-height: 72px; padding: 12px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
.inventory-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.inventory-row > div:first-child { display: grid; }
.inventory-row small { color: #557078; font-size: 12px; }
.quantity-control { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px 52px 44px; align-items: center; }
.quantity-control button, .quantity-control input { height: 44px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #91abb0; border-radius: 0; text-align: center; }
.quantity-control button { padding: 0; color: #004f62; background: #fbfaf7; font-size: 23px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.quantity-control button:hover { color: #ffffff; background: #004f62; }
.quantity-control button:first-child { border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px; }
.quantity-control button:last-child { border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; }
.quantity-control input { padding: 6px; border-inline: 0; -moz-appearance: textfield; }
.quantity-control input::-webkit-inner-spin-button, .quantity-control input::-webkit-outer-spin-button { margin: 0; appearance: none; }
.custom-volume { margin-top: 16px; padding: 16px; border: 1px dashed #afc5c8; border-radius: 12px; background: #fbfaf7; }
.custom-volume .input-suffix { max-width: 210px; }
.custom-volume small { color: #557078; font-weight: 500; }
.volume-summary, .quote-estimate { padding: 24px; border-top: 5px solid #f39200; border-radius: 12px; color: #ffffff; background: #003f50; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
.volume-summary { position: sticky; top: 118px; }
.summary-kicker { display: block; color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.volume-summary > strong, .quote-estimate > strong { margin: 8px 0 12px; display: block; color: #ffffff; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -.025em; }
.volume-summary > p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.76); font-size: 13px; }
.summary-rule { margin: 24px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.volume-summary dl, .quote-estimate dl { margin: 0; }
.volume-summary dl div, .quote-estimate dl div { padding: 10px 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
.volume-summary dt, .quote-estimate dt { color: rgba(255,255,255,.66); font-size: 12px; }
.volume-summary dd, .quote-estimate dd { margin: 0; color: #ffffff; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 760; text-align: right; }
.volume-summary .summary-note { margin: 16px 0 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.68); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; }
.final-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(280px, .72fr); align-items: start; gap: 32px; }
.quote-estimate > p { margin: 16px 0 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,.72); font-size: 12px; }
.consent { grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr; align-items: start; }
.consent input { width: 20px; min-height: 20px; margin-top: 2px; }
.form-actions { margin-top: 32px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; }
.form-error { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 8px; color: #b42318; background: #fff0ed; font-weight: 700; }
.server-error { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.bcz-honeypot { position: absolute !important; left: -10000px !important; width: 1px !important; height: 1px !important; overflow: hidden !important; }
.prototype-note { margin: 16px 0 0; color: #557078; font-size: 11px; text-align: right; }
.no-js-note { margin-bottom: 24px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #eccf9d; border-left: 5px solid #f39200; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff3df; }
.no-js-note p { margin: 4px 0 0; }

.site-footer { padding-top: 96px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.74); border-top: 6px solid #f39200; background: #082630; }
.footer-lead { padding-bottom: 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 64px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
.footer-lead h2 { max-width: 720px; margin-bottom: 0; color: #ffffff; }
.footer-lead .eyebrow { color: #ffc667; }
.footer-actions { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.footer-grid { padding-top: 64px; padding-bottom: 64px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.3fr repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 48px; }
.footer-grid > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.footer-grid strong { margin-bottom: 8px; color: #ffffff; }
.footer-grid a, .cookie-settings-link { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: inherit; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.cookie-settings-link { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.footer-brand .brand-logo { width: min(100%, 232px); margin-bottom: 16px; padding: 9px; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; }
.footer-brand p { max-width: 310px; font-size: 14px; }
.footer-bottom { padding: 24px 0 32px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); font-size: 12px; }
.footer-legal { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 24px; }
.mobile-actions { display: none; }
#ht-ctc-chat, #wpconsent-consent-floating { display: none !important; }

@media (max-width: 1060px) {
  #site-nav a { padding-inline: 10px; font-size: 13px; }
  .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 64px; }
  .hero-copy { max-width: 850px; }
  .estimator { max-width: 760px; }
  .photo-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr; }
  .photo-card-wide { grid-row: span 2; }
  .service-hero-grid, .pricing-grid, .split, .faq-grid, .editorial-grid, .content-grid, .quote-layout, .review-layout, .quote-intro-grid, .calculator-layout, .box-tool-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
  .quote-intro-photo { max-width: 760px; height: 360px; }
  .inventory-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 260px; }
  .calculator-summary { position: static; max-width: 760px; }
  .decision-card, .contact-card, .review-score { max-width: 760px; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 1fr 1fr; }
  .footer-grid > div:last-child { grid-column: 2 / 4; }
  .authority-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .local-check-grid, .definition-grid-four { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .authority-item:nth-child(3) { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
  .authority-item:nth-child(4) { border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
}
@media (max-width: 820px) {
  .utility { display: none; }
  .nav-shell { min-height: 70px; }
  .menu-toggle { display: block; }
  .header-cta { display: none; }
  #site-nav { position: absolute; inset: 100% 0 auto; max-height: calc(100vh - 74px); padding: 16px 24px 32px; display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0; overflow: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(8, 38, 48, .09); }
  #site-nav.open { display: flex; }
  #site-nav a { min-height: 54px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e2e3; font-size: 16px; }
  .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .trust-grid > div:nth-child(3) { border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
  .trust-grid > div:nth-child(4) { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15); }
  .section-heading { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .footer-lead { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
  .footer-actions { max-width: 380px; }
  .quote-proof { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  .inventory-layout, .final-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .calculator-panel { padding: 32px; }
  .address-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stopover-access-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .volume-summary { position: static; }
  .access-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .access-grid > label:last-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  html { scroll-padding-top: 112px; }
  body { padding-bottom: 72px; font-size: 16px; }
  input, select, textarea, button, summary { scroll-margin-block: 120px; }
  .shell { width: min(calc(100% - 32px), 1180px); }
  .concept-bar { padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 10px; }
  .nav-shell { min-height: 66px; gap: 12px; }
  .brand-logo { width: 164px; }
  #site-nav { max-height: calc(100vh - 70px); }
  h1 { font-size: clamp(37px, 10.8vw, 46px); line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(28px, 8.5vw, 37px); }
  .lead { font-size: 17px; }
  .home-hero, .pricing-hero, .inner-hero { padding: 64px 0 72px; }
  .service-hero { padding: 48px 0 64px; }
  .quote-hero { padding: 32px 0 48px; }
  .quote-intro-photo { height: 230px; }
  .hero-grid, .service-hero-grid, .quote-layout { gap: 32px; }
  .hero-actions .button { width: 100%; }
  .breadcrumbs { margin-bottom: 32px; }
  .estimator, .decision-card, .quote-form, .side-note, .contact-card, .review-score, .calculator-panel, .calculator-summary, .box-converter { padding: 24px 16px; border-radius: 12px; }
  .estimator h2, .decision-card h2, .form-step h2 { font-size: 27px; }
  .estimator-heading { display: block; }
  .step-badge { margin-top: 8px; display: inline-block; }
  .field-grid, .choice-grid, .three-fields, .access-grid, .service-choice-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; }
  .choice-grid { gap: 8px; }
  .access-grid, .service-choice-grid { gap: 8px; }
  .access-grid > label:last-child { grid-column: auto; }
  .choice-grid label span { min-height: 70px; }
  .address-card { padding: 16px; }
  .address-fields { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 92px; gap: 12px; }
  .postcode-field { grid-column: 1; }
  .number-field { grid-column: 2; }
  .addition-field { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .street-field, .city-field { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .trust-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .trust-grid > div { min-height: 86px; padding: 16px 12px; }
  .trust-grid strong { font-size: 13px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
  .section { padding-top: 72px; padding-bottom: 72px; }
  .service-grid, .process, .definition-grid, .article-grid, .footer-grid, .photo-grid, .authority-grid, .local-check-grid, .timeline-grid, .source-panel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .photo-card, .photo-card img { min-height: 270px; }
  .photo-card-wide { grid-row: auto; }
  .service-card { min-height: auto; padding: 24px; grid-template-columns: 46px 1fr; column-gap: 16px; }
  .card-number { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .visual-story { min-height: 340px; }
  .rate-row { min-height: 84px; padding: 16px; gap: 12px; }
  .rate-row > div:last-child strong { font-size: 18px; }
  .rate-row span { font-size: 11px; }
  .calculation-row { min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 16px; }
  .calculation-row span { font-size: 13px; }
  .process, .definition-grid { gap: 24px; }
  .process li, .definition-grid article { min-height: auto; padding: 24px 0; }
  .local-check-card, .tip-card { min-height: auto; padding: 24px; }
  .source-panel { padding: 24px; gap: 16px; }
  .journey article { padding: 48px 0; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  .journey article > span { font-size: 34px; }
  .facts div { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2px; }
  .review-item { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .review-item p { font-size: 17px; }
  .authority-item, .authority-item:nth-child(3), .authority-item:nth-child(4) { min-height: 90px; padding: 16px; border-left: 0; border-top: 1px solid #d7e2e3; }
  .authority-item:first-child { border-top: 0; }
  .form-progress { margin: 0 0 32px; padding: 0 0 6px; overflow: visible; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .form-progress span { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; font-size: 9px; }
  .form-progress b { width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-basis: 22px; }
  .inventory-toolbar { align-items: flex-start; }
  .calculator-panel .inventory-toolbar { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
  .calculator-panel .text-button { align-self: flex-start; }
  .inventory-group summary { padding-inline: 12px; }
  .inventory-items { padding-inline: 12px; }
  .inventory-row { align-items: start; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  .quantity-control { justify-self: stretch; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(58px, 1fr) 48px; }
  .volume-summary > strong, .quote-estimate > strong { font-size: 26px; }
  .form-actions { justify-content: stretch; }
  .form-actions .button { flex: 1; padding-inline: 10px; }
  .footer-lead { padding-bottom: 48px; }
  .footer-actions .button { width: 100%; }
  .footer-grid { gap: 32px; }
  .footer-grid > div:last-child { grid-column: auto; }
  .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; }
  .footer-grid a, .cookie-settings-link { min-height: 44px; }
  .mobile-actions { position: fixed; z-index: 60; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; min-height: 68px; padding: 8px 12px max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #afc5c8; background: rgba(255,255,255,.98); box-shadow: 0 -8px 24px rgba(8,38,48,.1); }
  .mobile-actions a { min-height: 50px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #004f62; border-radius: 8px; color: #004f62; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 780; text-decoration: none; }
  .mobile-actions a:first-child { border-color: #f39200; color: #302000; background: #f39200; }
  #ht-ctc-chat { display: none !important; }
  #wpconsent-consent-floating { display: none !important; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
  *, *::before, *::after { transition: none !important; }
}

/* WordPress/Divi compatibility for redesigned pages only */
body:has(.bcz-full-site) #main-header,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) #main-footer,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) .et-l--header,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) .et-l--footer,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) .entry-title,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) .main_title { display:none!important; }

body:has(.bcz-full-site) #main-content,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) #main-content .container,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) article,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) .entry-content { width:100%!important; max-width:none!important; margin:0!important; padding:0!important; }
body:has(.bcz-full-site) #main-content .container:before { display:none!important; }
.bcz-full-site { color:#102f3a; background:#fff; }
.bcz-full-site .site-header { top:0px; }
body:has(.bcz-full-site) #ht-ctc-chat,
body:has(.bcz-full-site) #wpconsent-consent-floating { display:none!important; }

</header><main id="main-content" tabindex="-1"><section class="hero home-hero"><div class="home-hero-media"><img src="{{BCZ_ASSET_BASE}}/real-moving-lift-overview.webp" width="1024" height="576" alt="Verhuiswagen en verhuislift van Busje komt zo tijdens een verhuizing in Utrecht" decoding="async" fetchpriority="high"></div><div class="shell hero-grid"><div class="hero-copy"><p class="eyebrow">Verhuisbedrijf in Utrecht en omgeving</p><h1>Verhuisbedrijf Utrecht voor een helder plan en duidelijke prijs.</h1><p class="lead">Bereken eerst uw verhuisvolume en prijsindicatie. Vraag daarna gericht een offerte aan voor een particuliere, zakelijke of spoedverhuizing in Utrecht en omgeving.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="button button-gold" href="/m3-calculator/">Bereken uw verhuisvolume</a><a class="button button-on-dark" href="/offerteaanvraag/">Vraag een offerte aan</a></div><ul class="proof-list"><li>Berekenen zonder contactgegevens</li><li>Bevestigde tarieven inclusief 21% btw</li><li>Persoonlijke beoordeling van uw aanvraag</li></ul></div><aside class="estimator" id="calculator" aria-labelledby="estimate-title">
  <div class="estimator-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">Direct inzicht</p><h2 id="estimate-title">Uw prijsindicatie</h2></div><span class="step-badge">Zonder contactgegevens</span></div>
  <p class="form-intro">Vul uw verwachte inzet in. Ieder onderdeel blijft zichtbaar.</p>
  <form id="estimate-form"><div class="field-grid"><label><span>Aantal verhuizers</span><select id="movers" name="movers"><option value="1">1 verhuizer</option><option value="2" selected>2 verhuizers</option><option value="3">3 verhuizers</option><option value="4">4 verhuizers</option></select></label><label><span>Verwachte uren</span><input id="hours" name="hours" type="number" min="1" max="24" step="0.5" value="4" inputmode="decimal"></label></div><label><span>Verwachte gereden kilometers</span><input id="kilometres" name="kilometres" type="number" min="0" max="1000" value="20" inputmode="numeric"></label></form>
  <div class="estimate-lines" aria-live="polite"><div><span>Verhuizers</span><strong id="labour-total">—</strong></div><div><span id="vehicle-label">Bestelbus · opdracht t/m 4 uur</span><strong id="vehicle-total">—</strong></div><div><span>Gereden kilometers</span><strong id="travel-total">—</strong></div><div class="subtotal"><span>Subtotaal excl. btw</span><strong id="subtotal">—</strong></div><div><span>21% btw</span><strong id="vat-total">—</strong></div><div class="grand-total"><span>Indicatie incl. btw</span><strong id="grand-total">—</strong></div></div>
  <p class="estimate-note" id="estimate-note">Dit is een berekening op basis van uw invoer, geen vaste offerte.</p><a class="button button-full" id="estimate-quote-link" href="/offerteaanvraag/">Neem deze indicatie mee</a>
</aside></div></section>

<section class="section shell real-work"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">Beelden van het verhuiswerk</p><h2>Voorbereid materieel en zorgvuldig ingepakte inboedel.</h2></div><p>Deze foto's zijn door het bedrijf aangeleverd en tonen echte verhuizingen, eigen materieel en zorgvuldig beschermd meubilair.</p></div><div class="photo-grid"><figure class="photo-card photo-card-wide"><img src="{{BCZ_ASSET_BASE}}/real-moving-lift-utrecht.webp" width="768" height="1024" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Verhuiswagen en verhuislift van Busje komt zo bij een woning in Utrecht"><figcaption>Eigen verhuiswagen en lift ingezet bij een Utrechtse woning</figcaption></figure><figure class="photo-card"><img src="{{BCZ_ASSET_BASE}}/real-moving-lift-overview.webp" width="1024" height="576" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Busje komt zo verhuiswagen en verhuislift tijdens een verhuizing"><figcaption>Verhuislift en wagen klaar voor het werk</figcaption></figure><figure class="photo-card"><img src="{{BCZ_ASSET_BASE}}/real-wrapped-cabinet.webp" width="1200" height="1600" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="Verhuizer van Busje komt zo beschermt een kast met verhuisdekens en folie"><figcaption>Kast beschermd met dekens en wikkelfolie</figcaption></figure></div></section>

<section class="section soft" id="utrecht-routekeuze"><div class="shell"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">Verhuizen in en rond Utrecht</p><h2>Verhuizen binnen, naar of vanuit Utrecht.</h2></div><p>Kies de route die bij uw aanvraag past. Daarna controleert u beide adressen, bereikbaarheid, volume en gewenste hulp.</p></div><div class="route-scenario-grid"><article class="route-scenario-card"><span>01</span><h3>Binnen Utrecht verhuizen</h3><p>Beschrijf vertrek en aankomst afzonderlijk. Etage, lift, loopafstand en laadruimte kunnen per adres verschillen.</p><a class="text-link" href="/werkgebied/#routecheck">Controleer een route binnen Utrecht →</a></article><article class="route-scenario-card"><span>02</span><h3>Naar Utrecht verhuizen</h3><p>Geef ook de aankomstzijde volledig door, zodat toegang, verkeersruimte en mogelijke voorbereiding beoordeeld kunnen worden.</p><a class="text-link" href="/verhuisbedrijf-utrecht/">Bereid aankomst in Utrecht voor →</a></article><article class="route-scenario-card"><span>03</span><h3>Vanuit Utrecht of omgeving</h3><p>Laat de volledige route beoordelen.
